_readme: Draft Barnwell walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: The war memorial

layers.essential_history: [[c:The war memorial stands near the church, remembering villagers who died in the World Wars.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Look for familiar village surnames among the names.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Robin the miller's son says he saw a light in the castle at midnight.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Robin's lantern count]]
material: [[c:ROBIN: "I saw the light come on at midnight and go out an hour and a half later."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:At what time did the light go out? (for example 1.30)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Half past one. Someone was in the castle for an hour and a half.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:Someone was in the castle from midnight to half past one.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head north, about 30 metres as the crow flies, to St Andrew's Church.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
